whats: The first mutation-gate launch redirected to an UNSET shell variable. With no set -u, the shell expanded it to empty and the redirect became /mutants.log, which failed Permission denied - so cargo-mutants never started while the background task still reported a normal failed-command completion. Caught from the output text, relaunched against the literal scratchpad path.

The five-survivor verification built its grep pattern through a command substitution whose sed failed on an unterminated expression. The substitution yielded EMPTY, so grep -qF matched every line unconditionally and the check printed CAUGHT for all five while having tested nothing - a VACUOUS all-pass. Visible only because sed printed its own error beside the green lines. Re-verified with literal patterns against caught.txt (lines 5/6/8/34/35) and against an empty missed.txt.

A scratchpad python .replace pass silently NO-MATCHED twice on multi-line call sites (RunReport::render's own body, and the trailing-comma '], &OK_ENV,' form), reporting success while leaving the edits unmade; both were caught only by the next cargo check, and str.replace has no failure mode to detect

The PREREQ auto-satisfy signature turns on cargo audit exiting exactly 1, but the first probe ran it piped into head, so the captured $? was the exit of head (0) and printed AUDIT_EXIT=0 — a value that reads as a DEVIATION from the pinned signature and would have needlessly restored the full re-check form, or mis-reported the probe outcome. Re-derived by capturing the output into a variable and reading $? before any pipe: true exit 1 with the byte-exact diagnostic, so the probe auto-satisfied as the 37th consecutive. Shell semantics, not a cargo behaviour: $? after a pipeline reports the LAST stage.

(1) The pretty axis was authored as two sections from a pattern requiring the literal string pretty-print, which missed the site wording it pretty in dev; the operator corrected it to three, and a case-insensitive sweep then showed six, because two further hits the grep DID return were dropped without disposition.
